title: Transparency-log checkpoint — the JWS payload published at /ct/checkpoint-latest.json
description:
A signed commitment to the transparency log's head, which is what makes retroactive tampering PROVABLE rather than merely unlikely (FS08-112). Signed with the same keys and JWKS as certificates — one of the signer's payload families — and published monthly at P-M2 and P-M3 (per publish batch from P-M4). At P-M2 the operator script emits it against Key Vault and commits it beside the log, together with a signed git tag on the website repository (FS08-113, VS-28).

This schema describes the DECODED payload. The published artifact at `/ct/checkpoint-latest.json` carries the compact JWS plus the decoded payload for convenience; a verifier must check the signature, not the convenience copy.

x-psn.producer: P-M2: operator script against Key Vault (VS-28) · P-M3: signer

asOf.description: The instant this checkpoint commits to.

headSeq.description: Global sequence number of the last entry in the log at `asOf`.

headSegmentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the head segment document as published.

kid.description: Echo of the JWS header `kid`, for readers of the decoded payload alone.
